bio.text: Robert Short is the Republican candidate for Wyoming Secretary of State in 2026.
In the WyoFile election guide response, Short says home is south of Douglas and most of life has been spent in Wyoming.
Short says election as Converse County Commissioner came in 2014, followed by two re-elections.
The response also says of work in technology, then a 20-year career in nuclear science, and the start of businesses in Douglas and Glenrock in 2004.
